# Image to PDF Converter — ImageCompress.in

> Free, fast, 100% browser-based Image to PDF converter. Convert JPG, JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, and BMP images to PDF locally without uploading files to any server.

## Tool URL
- [Image to PDF Converter](https://image-to-pdf.imagecompress.in/): Main converter application.
- [ImageCompress.in Home](https://www.imagecompress.in/): Parent image utility suite.

## Key Capabilities
- **Supported Input Formats**: JPG, JPEG, PNG, WebP, GIF, and BMP (up to 25 files per batch, 25 MB each).
- **Output Options**: Individual PDF per image, Batch ZIP download for multiple PDFs, or merge multiple images into a single multi-page PDF.
- **Page Sizing & Editing**: Fit to Image (original resolution), A4 (auto portrait/landscape), or US Letter (auto portrait/landscape), custom margins (None, Small, Large), drag-to-reorder, and 90° image rotation.
- **100% Client-Side Privacy**: Uses in-browser PDF generation (`pdf-lib` and HTML5 Canvas). Images never leave the user's device.
- **Cost**: 100% free, no registration, no watermarks.

## Quick How-To
1. Click the drop zone or drag and drop up to 5 images.
2. Optionally enable "Merge all selected images into a single PDF".
3. Click "Convert to PDF" and download the generated PDF immediately.
